__comment: Reusable base config for training.py. CLI flags override any value here.

training.__comment: Main optimization settings; set batch to an integer or 'full' for full-batch GD after prototype inclusion/exclusion

optimizer.__comment: Choose one mode: plain SGD, Adam, or momentum SGD

sharpness.__comment: lambda_max tracking and optional one-shot lr drop triggered by lambda_max

measurement_toggles.__comment: Usually leave these off unless a run specifically needs them

input_prototypes.__comment: Unified train/val input-prototype workflow; counts are per class

continuation.__comment: Resume from an existing wandb checkpointed run if needed

wandb.__comment: These supplement WANDB_PROJECT from the environment
